pipelineProvenance: degraded: autopilot phases (plan -> red -> green -> verify) run inline by the fleet build worker; no harness-autopilot session artifact
assumptions: Granularity is per file row: the sticky renders one row per file or unit, and merged-diff suppressions are located per file.

'Lines become covered' = a coverage-verified finding on the first sticky revision is absent from the last revision while its file is still in the merged PR's files; heuristic/graph findings that disappear are ambiguous.
A bare 'fp:' suppression counts as a false positive: the prefix is the verdict.
A never-edited sticky (totalCount 0) has one revision; fewer edit nodes than totalCount, or a null diff, is 'no edit history' and is counted in the report.
Window defaults to --days 14, at most 300 merged PRs; a larger window throws instead of truncating.
'precision' survives as the derived report command; only reaction collection is removed.
